prompts: The model configs our coding harnesses use are in {WS}: OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code each get one. They disagree about the context window of fast-coder: OpenCode's config says 262144, the other two say 131072. 262144 is the right value. Make all three agree, for good. Every other model setting stays as it is.
answers:
[goal] Make OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code configs agree on fast-coder context window = 262144, permanently, without touching other settings.

[action] Found the layout in README.md: `models.json` is the source of truth, `gen.py` writes the three harness configs into `out/`, and the install step copies `out/` to each harness. The disagreement was drift: `out/opencode.json` had been hand-edited to 262144 while the source `models.json` still said 131072, so any regeneration would have reverted OpenCode's value. Per house rules (edit the source of truth, never a generated copy), I changed `fast-coder.context_window` from 131072 to 262144 in `models.json` (one number, one line) and ran `python gen.py` to regenerate all three configs.

[result] Verified with actual command output:
- `python gen.py` rewrote `out/opencode.json`, `out/codex.toml`, `out/claude.json`.
- `Select-String -Path out\* -Pattern "262144|131072"` shows exactly one 262144 per file (`out/claude.json:5`, `out/codex.toml:2`, `out/opencode.json:9`) and no 131072.
- `Select-String -Path models.json,out\* -Pattern "131072"` returns nothing: the stale value is gone from source and all copies.
- Source dump confirms every other setting is untouched: `fast-coder 262144/16384/true`, `deep-thinker 200000/32768/true`, `tiny-chat 32768/4096/false`.

Why it is right "for good": all three renderers in `gen.py` read the same `context_window` field, so the single source edit propagates to all three outputs, and future runs of `gen.py` will keep them in agreement instead of reverting the hand-edited copy.

Assumptions: the 262144 value given in the brief is authoritative; `out/` is generated and safe to overwrite (README states this); the install step that copies `out/` into the harnesses is outside this repo and was not run.

[next] Nothing further needed here; the workstation install step will pick up the corrected `out/` on its next copy. No browser tabs or apps were opened.
